mapper.select: SELECT H.HSTRY_SN AS HISTORY_ID, H.HSTRY_YR AS YEAR, H.HSTRY_MM AS MONTH, H.HSTRY_CN AS CONTENT, ( SELECT F.ATCH_FILE_PATH_NM FROM ATCH_FILE_INFO F WHERE F.ATCH_FILE_MNG_NO = H.IMG_FILE_ID ORDER BY F.FILE_SEQ DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS IMAGE_URL FROM HMPG_HSTRY H WHERE H.DEL_YN = 'N' AND H.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY H.HSTRY_YR DESC, H.HSTRY_MM DESC, H.HSTRY_SN DESC
